Product Description

This Mead Composition Book is the classic choice for your notetaking needs. With 100, double sided, wide ruled pages, you'll have plenty of space to take notes, journal, draw and more. Smooth binding helps keep pages securely in place and won't snag on your clothing or backpack. Plus, the inside covers feature a class schedule, multiplication tables, conversion tables and grammar rules to help you stay organized. Each page measures 7-1/2" x 9-3/4". The composition book comes in classic black marble. 3 Pack.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Great find!
      Reviewed in the United States on May 13, 2026
      Size: Pack of 3
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I bought this Mead Composition Notebook 3-pack for my 5th grader, and it has been perfect for school use. The wide-ruled pages are great for kids who are still working on handwriting, giving them enough space to write neatly and stay organized.

      The notebooks are durable with a sturdy black marble cover that holds up well in backpacks. Even with daily use, they don’t easily bend or fall apart like cheaper notebooks sometimes do. The binding feels secure, so the pages stay intact throughout the school year.

      Each notebook has 100 sheets, which is a good amount for classwork, homework, and notes. The paper quality is solid and works well with pencils and pens without too much bleed-through or smudging.

      I also like that having a 3-pack makes it very convenient for different subjects. It helps keep my child’s schoolwork organized without needing to constantly buy replacements.

      The only minor downside is that the pages are fairly basic and not tear-out friendly, but that’s expected for composition books.

      Overall, this is a reliable and affordable school supply set that works very well for elementary students. I would definitely recommend it for everyday classroom use.

    • JP De Oliveira Estêvão
      5 out of 5 stars
      Great quality price - it does the job!
      Reviewed in the United States on March 19, 2026
      Size: Pack of 3
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      First of all, the paper quality? Surprisingly good. I went in expecting “standard school notebook energy,” and instead got paper that actually respects your pen. Ink does not bleed through like it is trying to escape, and writing on it feels smooth enough to make you briefly believe you have your life together.

      Each notebook has 100 sheets, which means you start off thinking, “I will use this responsibly,” and end up halfway through with random lists, doodles, and one page that just says “get it together” written ten times. Plenty of space for both productivity and mild existential spirals.

      The size is perfect. Not too small where you feel cramped, not too big where it becomes a commitment. It fits in a backpack without drama, which is more than I can say for most things in life.

      Durability? Solid. These can survive being tossed around, shoved into bags, and opened aggressively when inspiration (or panic) hits. The classic composition cover also gives that timeless “serious note-taker” look, even if what you are actually writing is a grocery list and passive-aggressive reminders to yourself.

      And getting three in a pack? That is optimism right there. Three chances to start fresh, be organized, and finally become the person who uses notebooks properly.

      4 out of 5 stars
      Ages quickly.
      Reviewed in the United States on May 5, 2026
      Size: Pack of 1
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The moment after you first buy it, the paper is very smooth, decently thick, and bleed-through resistant. However after a few months it starts to lose that, becoming more coarse, grainy, and seems to lose it's quality via aging. So far I've bought two of them, the first one I bought is very easy to tear on accident and is not bleed-through resistant at all. With the newer one, it used to be very good and I could even write on it with permanent marker without any bleed-through. Now the marker bleeds through 2-3 pages after a few months of it sitting on a shelf. If you're gonna use it up quick, I highly recommend it. If not, you might want to find something a little better. Overall, a decent notebook. 4 stars.

      Reseña detallada: Paquete de 12 cuadernos Mead Square Wide Ruled

      Cuando se trata de encontrar cuadernos funcionales y accesibles, los Mead Square Wide Ruled en paquete de 12 son una opción confiable para estudiantes, profesionales y cualquier persona que necesite organizar sus apuntes. Con un diseño práctico y un formato cómodo, estos cuadernos ofrecen una solución eficiente para el día a día.

      Diseño y materiales

      Los cuadernos Mead Square Wide Ruled tienen un tamaño compacto, lo que los hace ideales para llevar en mochilas, bolsos o incluso carteras sin ocupar demasiado espacio. La portada, aunque sencilla, es lo suficientemente resistente para soportar el uso regular, aunque no es rígida como las versiones de tapa dura.

      En cuanto a la encuadernación, están engrapados en el lomo, lo que mantiene las hojas seguras, pero no permite abrirlos completamente planos sin riesgo de que se despeguen con el tiempo. Sin embargo, este diseño ayuda a que sean más ligeros y fáciles de manejar.

      Calidad del papel

      Uno de los puntos más importantes en cualquier cuaderno es el papel, y en este caso, los Mead cumplen bien su función. El gramaje es adecuado para evitar que la tinta de bolígrafos o lápices se traspase fácilmente a la siguiente hoja. No obstante, si se usan marcadores o plumas de gel muy húmedas, puede haber un leve traspaso.

      El rayado Wide Ruled (líneas anchas) es perfecto para quienes prefieren un espacio amplio entre renglones, lo que facilita la lectura y la escritura ordenada. Este formato es ideal para estudiantes de primaria, personas que escriben con letra grande o quienes necesitan tomar notas rápidas sin preocuparse por la alineación del texto.

      Uso y funcionalidad

      Estos cuadernos son una gran elección para estudiantes de todas las edades, ya que ofrecen suficiente espacio para escribir sin ser voluminosos. También son útiles para oficinas, listas de tareas o incluso llevar un diario personal. Sin embargo, es importante considerar que no tienen perforaciones para carpeta, por lo que si se necesitan hojas sueltas, habrá que desprenderlas manualmente.

      Ventajas y desventajas

      ✅ Ventajas:

      • Excelente relación calidad-precio, especialmente en paquetes grandes.

      • Tamaño compacto y fácil de transportar.

      • Papel de buena calidad con líneas anchas para escritura clara.

      • Diseño ligero y funcional.

      ❌ Desventajas:

      • No tienen perforaciones para archivadores.

      • La portada es flexible y podría desgastarse con el tiempo.

      • La encuadernación con grapas limita la apertura plana.

      Conclusión

      El paquete de 12 cuadernos Mead Square Wide Ruled es una compra inteligente para quienes buscan cuadernos prácticos, asequibles y de buena calidad. Son ideales para uso escolar, universitario o personal, ofreciendo un balance entre durabilidad y comodidad. Aunque no cuentan con algunos extras como perforaciones o tapas rígidas, cumplen su función de manera efectiva y son una opción confiable para el día a día.

    About this Item

    • Composition book contains 100 double-sided sheets; A classic favorite for journaling and lab notes
    • Wide ruling gives you plenty of writing space for notetaking
    • Sewn binding is smooth, helps keep pages securely in place and lays flat when open
    • Inside covers feature a class schedule, multiplication tables, conversion tables and grammar rules
    • Pages measure 7.5" x 9.75"; Black Marble Soft Cover; 3 Pack

    Product Description

    This Mead Composition Book is the classic choice for your notetaking needs. With 100, double sided, wide ruled pages, you'll have plenty of space to take notes, journal, draw and more. Smooth binding helps keep pages securely in place and won't snag on your clothing or backpack. Plus, the inside covers feature a class schedule, multiplication tables, conversion tables and grammar rules to help you stay organized. Each page measures 7-1/2" x 9-3/4". The composition book comes in classic black marble. 3 Pack.
